common.error: That didn't work. Close Call's engine didn't answer; try again in a moment.
common.startup_error: Close Call couldn't start its settings window: {{error}}

title.mirrored: This screen is mirrored to another display

body.idle: Close Call acts the moment a share starts, a projector connects or the lid closes. Until then it only watches.
body.sharing: Guard is on. Anything sensitive that opens now gets closed or hidden straight away.
body.mirrored: Guard is on. Anything sensitive that opens on this screen gets closed or hidden straight away.
body.paused: Nothing is closed automatically until then. The panic hotkey still works.

home.call_likely: A call looks like it's about to start. Now is a good moment to clean up.

sim.title: If a screen share started now
sim.lead: Dry run. Nothing has been touched yet.
sim.nothing: Nothing would be touched: no open item matches a rule armed by a screen share.

home.open_now_lead: What the panic hotkey would close or hide this minute.
home.preflight_lead: What Close Call needs to act in time.
home.last_run_none: Nothing has run yet. Press the panic hotkey or simulate a share to see what happens.

when.call_likely: A call is about to start
when.item_open_longer_than: An item is open longer than

target_hint.tab: One tab at a time, in Chrome, Safari, Edge, Brave, Arc and Firefox.
target_hint.document: PDFs, Word files and other open documents.
target_hint.app_window: Single windows, such as a chat window.
target_hint.process: Every window of an app at once.

action_hint.close: Tabs and documents can be restored from Activity for a while.
action_hint.hide: Instant and lossless. The app keeps running in the background.
action_hint.minimize: Sends the window to the Dock. It animates, so it's a last resort.
action_hint.quit: Quits the whole app. Never part of the recommended rules.
action_hint.notify_only: Nothing is touched; you get a notification with a count.

unsaved.skip_and_notify: Leave it open and tell me

unsaved_hint.save_then_close: Never-saved documents go to {{folder}} where the app allows it. Otherwise they are hidden.
unsaved_hint.hide: The document stays open with its changes, out of sight.
unsaved_hint.skip_and_notify: Nothing happens to it; you get a notification.
unsaved_hint.discard: Unsaved changes are lost. Use it only for documents you never edit.

confirm.countdown: Count down first, with a Keep button

group_hint.any: matches when at least one condition below does
group_hint.all: matches only when every condition below does
group_hint.not: matches when the condition below doesn't

matcher.private_hint: Incognito and private windows, where the browser tells us.

rules.title: Rules
rules.lead: Each rule says when to act, what to look at, and what to do with it.
rules.empty_body: Without rules Close Call only watches. Start from the recommended set or write your own.
rules.reset_confirm: This replaces all your rules with the recommended set.

editor.issues_one: {{count}} thing to fix before this rule can be saved.
editor.issues_other: {{count}} things to fix before this rule can be saved.
editor.other_issues_one: Another rule has a problem too ({{count}}). Open it from the list to fix it.
editor.other_issues_other: Other rules have problems too ({{count}}). Open them from the list to fix them.
editor.name: Name
editor.name_hint: Shown in Activity when this rule acts. Leave it empty to keep the suggested name.
editor.name_placeholder: For example: Close the payroll portal when sharing
editor.when_hint: Any of these arms the rule.
editor.share_hint: Uses the detection confidence set in Settings.
editor.match_hint: What makes an item sensitive. Protected items are never touched, whatever this says.
editor.except_hint: Items that match this are left alone.
editor.quit_warning: Quitting closes every document of the app under the unsaved-changes setting below. Some apps reopen their documents the next time they start.
editor.on_unsaved: If a document has unsaved changes
editor.on_unsaved_hint: Unknown means unsaved: Close Call never guesses with your work.
editor.confirm_hint: A countdown lets you keep the item. It only works for idle and open-too-long triggers.
editor.confirm_not_allowed: A countdown is only possible when every trigger is idle or open-too-long. During a share or lock there is no time to ask, and a dialog would show on the shared screen.
editor.delete_confirm: Delete this rule? This can't be undone.

categories.title: Categories
categories.lead: The lists rules refer to. Built-in lists ship with each release; Close Call never downloads anything.
categories.empty_title: No categories of your own yet
categories.empty_body: Group the sites, apps and files that are sensitive for you, such as your employer's payroll portal, then use the group in a rule.
categories.builtin_lead: Snapshots of public lists plus hand-checked entries. Categories that no rule uses do nothing; opt-in ones are left out of the recommended rules.

editor.name: Name
editor.id_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Rules refer to the category by this.
editor.id_invalid: Use only lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
editor.id_taken: A category with this ID already exists.
editor.domains_hint: One per line, without https://. Subdomains count too.
editor.apps_hint: One per line: a bundle ID such as com.apple.Notes, or the app's name.
editor.keywords_hint: One per line. Case and accents don't matter.
editor.delete_confirm: Delete this category? This can't be undone.
editor.delete_used_one: {{count}} rule uses this category; its conditions will match nothing. Delete anyway?
editor.delete_used_other: {{count}} rules use this category; their conditions will match nothing. Delete anyway?

adult.name: Adult
adult.description: Adult sites from public blocklists, merged and deduplicated.

banking.name: Banking
banking.description: Netbanks and bank sites (Hungarian banks checked by hand), plus “Internetbank”-style window titles.

webmail.name: Webmail
webmail.description: Gmail, Outlook, Proton, Freemail, Citromail and other mail in the browser.

medical.name: Health
medical.description: Patient portals such as EESZT, lab results and health titles. Hand-curated: no open health list exists.

password_managers.name: Password managers
password_managers.description: Passwords, Keychain Access, 1Password, Bitwarden and similar apps.

messengers.name: Messengers
messengers.description: Messages, Signal, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and similar apps.

invoices.name: Invoices and payslips
invoices.description: Documents named like számla, invoice, bérjegyzék, payslip or bank statement.

meeting.name: Meeting apps
meeting.description: Zoom, Teams, Meet, FaceTime, Webex, Discord and OBS. Protected so a cleanup never ends your call.

preset.share-hide-private-apps: Hide password managers and messengers when sharing
preset.share-close-invoices: Close invoices and payslips when sharing
preset.lid-close-adult: Close adult tabs when the lid closes
preset.away-close-banking: Close banking tabs after 15 minutes away
preset.bank-tab-open-too-long: Offer to close banking tabs open for 2 hours
preset.private-windows-on-share: Close private and incognito tabs when sharing

error.duplicate_rule_id: Another rule already uses this ID.
error.empty_targets: Pick at least one kind of item to look at.
error.countdown_not_allowed: A countdown only works when every trigger is idle or open-too-long.
error.empty_composite: This group has no conditions. Add one or remove the group.
error.lone_not: “Not” on its own matches almost everything. Combine it with another condition under “All of”.
error.invalid_glob: This pattern isn't valid. Check that every [ and { is closed.
error.invalid_domain: Enter a bare domain such as otpbank.hu, without https:// or a path.
error.unsupported_version: This configuration was written by a newer Close Call. Update the app to edit it.

reason.automation_missing: Close Call isn't allowed to control this app yet, so it hid the whole app.
reason.unsaved_hidden: It had unsaved changes, so it was hidden instead of closed.
reason.unsaved_skipped: It had unsaved changes, so it was left open.
reason.untitled_hidden: It was never saved and the app can't save it to a folder, so it was hidden.
reason.firefox_no_tab_close: Firefox can't close single tabs without a visible shortcut, so Firefox was hidden.
reason.no_tab_close: This browser can't close single tabs, so its window was hidden.
reason.changed_before_action: It changed right before acting (another page or file), so it was left alone.
reason.timeout: The app didn't respond in time.
reason.permission_missing: Accessibility access is off, so Close Call can't see or close windows.
reason.elevated_window: The window runs as administrator, and Windows doesn't let other apps close it.
reason.kept_by_user: You chose Keep during the countdown.
reason.not_while_sharing: Permission prompts are never shown during a share.
reason.unsupported: This app doesn't allow that action.
reason.watcher_noisy: Reports activity even when nothing is happening, often because of a dock or a recording tool. Used only as a hint.
reason.symbol_missing: Not available on this version of the system. The hotkey, projector and lid triggers still work.
reason.x11_no_share_detection: X11 can't tell when the screen is captured. Use the panic hotkey before sharing.
reason.private_not_restorable: Private tabs are never reopened, so they don't end up in your history.

note.tab_hide_minimizes: Minimizes the tab's window, or switches to a safe neighbour tab.
note.safari_private_unknown: Can't tell private windows apart from normal ones.
note.firefox_session_file: Reads the session file, about 15 seconds behind, without private windows. Hides Firefox instead of closing tabs.
note.sheet_by_role: Save dialogs are answered by button role, so it works in any language.
note.autosave_discard_hides: “Close without saving” hides instead, because these apps save on their own.
note.minimize_animates: Minimizing animates into the Dock, visible on a shared screen.
note.app_hide_all_windows: Hides the whole app only when every one of its windows matches.
note.needs_automation: Needs permission to control the app.
note.url_active_tab_only: Sees the address of the active tab only.
note.elevated_skipped: Windows running as administrator are skipped.
note.atspi_restart_browser: Needs desktop accessibility on and a browser restart.

permission.not_while_sharing: Not while sharing: the prompt would show on the shared screen.
permission.asks_when_open: It isn't running. Close Call will ask as soon as you open it.

activity.title: Activity
activity.lead: Kept in memory only. It's gone when you quit Close Call, and restore works for {{duration}}.
activity.empty_body: When Close Call closes or hides something, it shows up here with the reason.

settings.title: Settings
settings.login_hint: Close Call can only protect you while it's running. It sits in the menu bar.
settings.hotkey_hint: Cleans up at once, from any app, even with this window closed.
settings.confidence_hint: How sure the system must be before share rules act.
settings.confidence_low: Low: also reacts to hints, more false alarms
settings.untitled_dir_hint: Used by “Save, then close” where the app allows it.
settings.restore_window_hint: Titles and addresses of closed items stay in memory this long, never on disk.
settings.protection_lead: Protected items are never touched, whatever the rules say.
settings.protect_audible_hint: Keeps the tab with your music or a video call.
settings.protect_pinned_hint: Pinned tabs are usually the ones you keep open on purpose.
settings.permissions_lead: Checked every time Close Call starts.
settings.capabilities: What I can see on this computer
settings.capabilities_lead: What Close Call can do here, app by app. Partly means it works with the limit shown.
settings.no_network: Close Call never connects to the internet: no accounts, no telemetry, no update checks. Everything it sees stays on this computer.
settings.licence: Free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later. The bundled lists keep their own licences.

welcome.title: Close what you'd rather nobody saw
welcome.body: Close Call closes or hides sensitive tabs, documents and apps the moment you share your screen, plug in a projector or close the lid, or when you press the panic hotkey.
welcome.promise_title: It never connects to the internet
welcome.promise_body: No accounts, no telemetry, no update checks. The lists it uses ship inside the app, and what it sees stays on this computer.
welcome.preset_recommended_hint: When you share: closes banking, webmail, health and adult tabs and every private tab, hides password managers and messengers, closes invoices. You can change every rule later.
welcome.preset_empty_hint: Close Call only watches until you write a rule.

accessibility.title: Let Close Call see your windows
accessibility.body: macOS asks for Accessibility access so Close Call can read window titles and which document is open, and close them. It never asks to record your screen.
accessibility.waiting: Switch on Close Call in System Settings. This page updates by itself.

automation.title: Allow each browser and document app
automation.body: macOS asks once per app, so Close Call can close one tab or document without touching the rest. It asks only for apps your rules touch, and never during a share.

notifications.title: Get a short note after each cleanup
notifications.body: Only counts, like “3 closed, 1 hidden”. Never titles, addresses or file names.

os.title: Worth changing in System Settings
os.body: Close Call never changes system settings. These take you to the right place.
os.dnd_hint: A message preview can pop up on the shared screen before anything can hide it.
os.password: Ask for the password right after sleep
os.password_hint: Otherwise waking the computer shows your desktop before you unlock it.
os.window_share: Share a window, not the whole screen
os.window_share_hint: In Zoom, Teams and Meet, picking one window keeps everything else private from the first frame.

dry_run.title: This is what I would do right now
dry_run.body: Your rules against what's open, as if a share started now. Nothing is touched.
dry_run.nothing: Nothing sensitive is open right now.

login.title: Start with your computer
login.body: Close Call can only protect you while it's running. It lives in the menu bar and uses no network.
